reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the signed contracts don't support 261 as the settled seat count for Quarrendon Freight Lines.

- **Now: 185 seats.** The 2026 renewal (signed 2026-03-20, effective 2026-04-01, renews 2027-03-31) doesn't change the seat count. So the 185 from Amendment No. 1, in effect since 2025-09-01, still holds. The account page also lists 185 active seats.
- **From 2027-01-01: 230 seats.** Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, raises the count on that date.

I told Dana that Ilse posted 261 here on 10/14, but no signed Quarrendon document I can see has that number. I suggested she enter 185 now and 230 from 2027-01-01, and check with Ilse where 261 came from first.

I only used the contracts and account page for the North team, which Dana owns. My reply gave seat counts and dates only, no pricing or discounts.
